author: Little Chinese Everywhere
description:
If you want to experience the China you see in our videos, come travel with us:
https://littlechineseeverywhere.com/tours

We tried one of China’s most unusual foods: cow dung hotpot! And yes, there’s a reason it’s called that. It’s made with the partially digested contents of a cow’s stomach, which are cooked in a hotpot. It’s particularly well known among the Dong people in Guizhou.
We travelled to a remote Dong village to try this unique dish. But that wasn’t all! The Dong people are also famous for their traditional singing, and we got to witness this beautiful tradition in one of their villages. 🇨🇳
